card.name: Start of eyelash and liver words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning with 'eyel' or 'L' (eyelash, eyelid, LIVER, Labetalol, Lethargy), usually after a section number, a bullet, or a sentence start.

modes.label: Eyelash/eyelid
modes.description: The 'el' piece inside Eyelash or Eyelid, mainly in warnings about eyelash changes.
modes.example: ( 5.1 ) • Ey<<el>>ash Changes: gradual change to eyelashes

modes.label: Capital L word start
modes.description: A capital L opening a word at the start of a sentence or heading, often in all-caps liver text or drug names like Labetalol.
modes.example: AT TIMES RESULTING IN<< L>>IVER TRANSPLANT AND DEATH.

card.plain: It fires at the start of words like eyelash, eyelid, liver or labetalol, where the word is only just beginning.
